hero.sub: Learn boxing properly and get in the best shape of your life. AI-built plans, real technique, progress you can see — first jab or hundredth round.

audience.sub: Most apps pick a lane — cardio for beginners or hardcore coaching for pros. RingBornn runs both, in one place. Start free, no card required.
audience.c1Copy: You want to get fit, build an athletic body and finally learn how to box — starting from absolute zero.
audience.c1p1: Guided from your very first jab
audience.c2Copy: You've got a background and you want structure — real progression that sharpens skill instead of wasting rounds.

features.sub: What other apps split across paid, app-only, hardware-locked products — all in one place, in your browser.
features.plan_c: Personalized, step-by-step sessions rebuilt every day around your profile and progress.
features.belt_c: Climb from Novice to Pro and watch a live bar close in on your goal and date.
features.streak_c: Show up daily and keep the fire lit. Consistency tracked separately from your goal.
features.video_c: Illustrated technique breakdowns that run in the browser — no app, no gear.
features.nutrition_c: Meal ideas tuned to your body stats and daily training load.
features.calorie_c: Track what you eat against what training burns, so you fuel the work properly.
features.rest_c: Smart rest days built into every plan, so you build strength instead of burning out.
features.circuits_c: Named formats fighters actually run — Cindy, Tabata, bag rounds — on a real timer with the round bell.
features.partners_c: Add a partner, watch each other's streak, and send challenges. Nobody trains alone.

finalCta.sub: Build your fighter profile in under a minute and unlock your first rank. No account, no card, no gear.

footer.tagline: Web-first boxing training for beginners and pros alike. Train like a fighter. Look like an athlete.

onb.pathSub: This sets where your training starts. You can't get it wrong — both paths lead to the same ring.
onb.profileSub: The more the coach knows, the sharper your plan. Nothing here leaves your browser until you save.
onb.goalsLabel: Training goals — pick all that apply
onb.customGoalPlaceholder: + Add your own goal (e.g. spar my brother, last 6 rounds)
onb.errWeight: Enter a real weight — 25–350 kg (55–770 lb).
onb.errHeight: Enter a real height — 90–250 cm (3–8.2 ft).
onb.errAge: You must be at least 16 to use RingBornn — enter an age from 16 to 100.
onb.errTarget: Enter a reachable target — 25–350 kg (55–770 lb).
onb.customTimeframePlaceholder: By when? (e.g. by my birthday in December, in 10 weeks)
onb.setupSub: Gym, a few bits at home, or nothing but your bodyweight — the coach builds around exactly what you've got.
onb.equipPlaceholder: Anything else? (e.g. a bar, a bench, stones, a pull-up frame)
onb.bodyweightNote: No gear? No problem. You'll get shadow boxing, footwork ladders and bodyweight strength circuits that build a real engine.
onb.fuelSub: Nutrition wins fights. We tailor food guidance to what you can actually get and afford — no unrealistic shopping lists.
onb.supSub: Whey, creatine, etc. Off? We build the plan on whole food only.
onb.dietPlaceholder: Allergies, vegetarian/halal, foods you hate, meals per day…
onb.customTimeframeHint: Say how long — for example “6 months”, “12 weeks” or “2 years”.
onb.customTimeframeUnreadable: Add a unit so we know the length — “6 months”, “12 weeks”, “2 years”.
onb.resumed: Picked up where you left off — your answers are saved.
onb.welcomeBackSub: Pick up where you were, or set new targets. Your streak, rank and training history stay either way.
onb.keepSub: Straight to your dashboard, nothing changes.
onb.rebuildSub: Answer the questions again with new goals, weight or equipment. Your progress is kept.

paths.beginnerP2: Build a base of fitness and skill
paths.experiencedBlurb: Got a background? We'll skip the basics and push your combinations, conditioning and ring IQ with structured, skill-building work.

admin.gateSub: Enter the admin login and password to open the control panel.
admin.gateUnconfigured: Set the ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable (in Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables) to enable the admin panel.
admin.empty: No users yet — people appear here after they sign in and open the dashboard.
admin.note: Plan changes reach the user's app the next time they open the dashboard. Banning wipes that user's data immediately and cannot be reversed.
admin.banConfirm:
Ban {email}?

This blocks their access AND permanently deletes their training history, progress and profile. It cannot be undone.
admin.problem_no_key: This deployment has no SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. Add it in Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables for the Production environment.
admin.problem_no_url: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL is not set on the server, so there is no project to connect to.
admin.problem_wrong_key: The value stored is a publishable or anon key, not the secret service-role key. In Supabase go to Project Settings → API → Secret keys and copy the key that starts with sb_secret_ (or the legacy service_role key).
admin.problem_query_failed: The key was accepted but the database returned an error:
admin.problemRedeploy: Environment variables only reach a NEW deployment. After changing one, redeploy before testing again.
admin.gateLocked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in about {minutes} min.
admin.activityEmpty: Nothing yet — actions appear here as they happen.
admin.activityFailed: Could not load the activity log.
admin.ticketReplyHint: Opens Gmail with the reply addressed and the ticket quoted
admin.ticketReplyPlaceholder: Your answer — they read this inside the site.
admin.ticketSentNote: Sent. They'll see it on the support page.
admin.conversionRunning: {n} still inside their trial — not counted.
admin.cohortsHelp: Each row is the people who signed up that week. Each column is how many of them were still training that many weeks later. A column reading “—” has not finished yet.
admin.cohortsEmpty: Not enough signups yet to show a cohort.

account.deleteWhat: Deleting your account removes it and everything attached to it from our servers:
account.deleteItem1: Your profile — body stats, goals, timeframe, equipment and notes.
account.deleteItem2: Your training history — trained days, streaks, XP, rank and logged meals.
account.deleteItem3: Your subscription record and your sign-in.
account.deleteFinal: This cannot be undone. There is no backup we can restore for you.
account.deleteFailed: Could not delete the account. Try again, or contact us.
account.deleteUnavailable: Account deletion is not configured on this deployment yet. Please contact us and we will delete it for you.
account.noSubscription: You have no paid subscription — nothing to manage yet.
account.billingFailed: Could not open the billing portal. Try again shortly.

support.intro: Tell us what happened and we'll get back to you by email. Every message reaches a person — there is no bot in between.
support.topicHint_bug: Something broke, looks wrong, or will not load. Tell us which page and what you were doing.
support.topicHint_billing: A charge you do not recognise, a refund, or trouble changing plan.
support.topicHint_account: You cannot log in, the email on the account is wrong, or you want it closed.
support.topicHint_data: Ask for a copy of your data, or ask us to delete it. We answer within 30 days.
support.topicHint_other: Anything else — a question, an idea, or feedback on the training.
support.emailHint: We only use this to answer you.
support.emailBad: That does not look like an email address.
support.messagePlaceholder: The more detail, the faster we can fix it. Which page, what you pressed, what you expected, and what happened instead.
support.privacyNote: Your message and email are stored so we can answer you, and deleted once the matter is closed. We never sell or share them.
support.errTooMany: You have sent several messages in the last hour. Give it a little time, or reply to our email instead.
support.errOffline: Messaging is temporarily unavailable. Please reach us on Telegram.
support.errFailed: That did not send. Check your connection and try again.
support.sentBody: We will reply to {email}. Most things get an answer within a couple of days — check your spam folder if it seems quiet.
support.otherBody: The form is the fastest route — it lands straight in our queue. Telegram works too, but we check it less often.
support.replyHereNote: We'll answer on this page, under Your requests — no need to watch your inbox. Come back and check.
support.replyMailNote: We'll answer by email. Log in before writing and you'll get the reply on this page instead.
support.sentBodyInApp: Your reply will appear on this page, under Your requests. Most things get an answer within a couple of days.

friends.sub: Add a training partner and you both see each other's streak. It is much harder to skip a day when someone is watching the number.
